VG035.message: Delivery type not defined for order type
VG035.cause: The delivery type in the sales order is not properly configured for the selected order type in SPRO.
VG035.resolution:
1. Go to SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Shipping > Deliveries > Define Delivery Types
2. Check that the delivery type is assigned to the order type
3. Verify the item category determination in VOV4

M7021.cause: The posting date field is empty in the goods movement transaction (MIGO).
M7021.resolution:
1. Enter a valid posting date in the header area
2. Ensure the posting date falls within an open fiscal period
3. Check FM period lock via transaction OB52

F5003.message: Account not found in chart of accounts
F5003.cause: The GL account number entered does not exist in the assigned chart of accounts.
F5003.resolution:
1. Verify the GL account number via FS00
2. Check the correct chart of accounts is assigned to the company code
3. Create the account if it doesn't exist using FS00 or via mass upload

VK011.cause: A pricing condition record with the same key combination already exists in the condition table.
VK011.resolution:
1. Go to VK12 to display existing condition records
2. Check the validity dates — they may overlap
3. Either modify the existing record or change the validity period of the new one

ME045.message: Authorization check failed for purchase order
ME045.cause: The user does not have the required authorization object (M_BEST_BSA or M_BEST_EKG) for the purchase order type or purchasing group.
ME045.resolution:
1. Check user authorizations via SU53 immediately after the error
2. Request the BASIS team to add the missing authorization object
3. Verify the purchasing group assignment in the user master (SU01)

KI235.message: Cost center does not exist for the period
KI235.cause: The cost center is either not created or not valid for the posting period.
KI235.resolution:
1. Check cost center master data in KS03
2. Verify the validity dates of the cost center
3. Extend the validity period if necessary using KS02

BM001.message: Material does not exist or is not active
BM001.cause: The material number entered is not found in the material master or is flagged for deletion.
BM001.resolution:
1. Check material master in MM03
2. Verify the material exists in the correct plant
3. Check if the material is flagged for deletion (deletion flag in MM02)

V1321.message: Pricing error: Condition record not found
V1321.cause: The pricing procedure could not find a valid condition record for the material/customer combination.
V1321.resolution:
1. Check pricing conditions in VK13
2. Verify the condition type is included in the pricing procedure
3. Check customer/material info records and condition exclusion groups
